title: Review of c46's prey fuel fork: replicated on fresh seed 7 (with and without predators) and at dt/2; prey 20 -> 0 after the fuel cut, fed twin keeps 20, prey material conserved
summary: Re-ran the claimed world.py with labkit on seed 7 (128^2, T=7000, fork at t=6000): fork, fed twin, predator-free fork, and the fork with the world's own step halved (dt 0.2 -> 0.1). Counts by count.py from the recorded frames (c>0.5, >=4 px). Fork: prey 20 -> 11 (t=6200) -> 2 (t=6500) -> 0 (t=6700); fed twin 20 at t=7000. Predator-free fork: 20 -> 0 by t=6400 with mean prey material 0.248 unchanged. dt/2 fork: 20 -> 0 by t=6650, same curve. Predators 23 -> 23 bodies, mean predator material 0.033 -> 0.079 after the cut.

observations.E: rerun/fork/sheet.png t=6100-7000 vs rerun/fed/sheet.png: every prey body dissolves after F=0, kF=0 at t=6000 (20 -> 0 by t=6700 with predators, by t=6400 without, rerun/fork_nopred/sheet.png), while the fed twin keeps 20; prey material mean 0.248 constant in the predator-free fork, so the bodies dissolve into solution rather than being consumed

seeds_run.result: pass (dt/2: WORLD_P dt 0.1, prey 20 -> 0 by t=6650)

controls_run.E: rerun/fed (fed twin), rerun/fork_nopred (predator-free fork), rerun/fork_dthalf (world step halved)

verdicts.limitation: With predators present the last 2 prey bodies last until t=6700, i.e. 700 t rather than the 'within 500 t' in the title (the predator-free fork clears in 400 t). The cut is global (whole domain), so this shows prey depend on the fuel, not that one body dies from a local supply loss; the world's cut_* switches for a local disk cut were not run. 128^2 only, one fresh seed. Predator dependence on prey is by construction, as the author says.
